strings.zh: 虽然也有只看重天赋素质的{NEWLINE}训练师,{CLEAR}但通过道具或者药物{CLEAR}合理运用,{CLEAR}也能极大地拓展{CLEAR}精灵的才能。
strings.en: Some Trainers rely on a Pokémon’s{NEWLINE}potential alone. But you can use items{CLEAR}and medicines to help improve a{CLEAR}Pokémon’s capabilities.

strings.zh: 无论是爬山还是精灵对战,{NEWLINE}最后决定一切的因素都是{CLEAR}天生的素质！{SCROLL}我不依赖药物或者道具,{NEWLINE}只凭着才能和训练{CLEAR}来应对决斗！
strings.en: Whether it’s mountain climbing or{NEWLINE}Pokémon battles, in the end, what{CLEAR}decides everything is natural potential!{SCROLL}I don’t rely on medicine or items. I{NEWLINE}take on battles with nothing but talent{CLEAR}and training!
